title: An Unsupervised Information-Theoretic Approach to Identifying Formulaic Clusters in Textual Data
reasoning: The paper uses the Hebrew Bible (Genesis, Exodus, and Leviticus) as its primary real-world application, specifically focusing on the theological source-critical distinction between 'Priestly' and 'Holiness' codes. This involves evaluating the text's composition in the context of religious scholarship and tradition.
